label: meaningful
label_meaning: meaningful: built from the seller's own published schema

best_provider.description: Best comparable provider only when at least two valid quotes are available.

confidence.description: Deterministic quote-comparison confidence; two providers never produce HIGH in this MVP.

consensus.description: Comparable-output median and comparison basis when two provider quotes are valid.

economic_advantage.description: Best quote versus declared baseline or next available quote; never ROI.

economics.description: Known or unknown estimated provider COGS; unknown is never represented as zero.

evidence_quality.description: Per-provider reported, calculated, estimated, or unavailable field quality.

partial.description: True when one or more providers did not yield a valid quote.

quotes.description: Normalized provider quote evidence in raw token units.

usage.description: Per-provider call success, latency, and configured cost-estimate availability.

attribution.derived_from: the schema and example output the seller publicly lists there
attribution.status: unclaimed: the owner can claim or remove the matching listing on the discovery board
